en.headline: Hong Kong Wine and Dine Festival opens at Central Harbourfront on Thursday
en.dek: The Tourism Board’s four-day event runs from 29 October to 1 November with international wine pavilions and local culinary offerings at the harbourfront and Tamar Park.
body: The Hong Kong Wine and Dine Festival returns to the Central Harbourfront Event Space and Tamar Park from Thursday, organised by the Hong Kong Tourism Board.

According to the Tourism Board, the event opens at 7.30pm on 29 October and runs until midnight, then from 1pm to 1am on 30 and 31 October, and from 1pm to midnight on 1 November. Visitors can enter via the Admiralty entrance next to Tamar Park or the Central entrance near Central Pier No. 10.

The festival features wine pavilions from France (with a Bordeaux focus), China, Georgia, Italy, Spain, the United Kingdom, Australia and South Korea, alongside sparkling teas, craft beers, Asian wines and cocktails. It also highlights local flavours under the theme of experiences exclusive to Hong Kong.
The organisers said the footprint has been extended this year and includes guided wine walks and masterclasses. Tickets and further details are available through official channels.

zh.headline: 香港美酒佳餐巡禮周四中環海濱開幕 為期四日
zh.dek: 旅遊發展局主辦的活動由10月29日至11月1日在中環海濱活動空間及添馬公園舉行，設多國酒展及本地美食。
body: 香港旅遊發展局主辦的香港美酒佳餐巡禮將於周四在中環海濱活動空間及添馬公園開幕。
根據旅發局資料，活動10月29日晚上七時半至午夜舉行，30及31日下午一時至凌晨一時，11月1日下午一時至午夜。入場可經添馬公園旁的金鐘入口，或中環10號碼頭旁的入口。
會場設有來自法國（重點波爾多）、中國、格魯吉亞、意大利、西班牙、英國、澳洲及韓國的酒展，並有汽泡茶、手工啤酒、亞洲葡萄酒及鴨尾酒。活動亦以「只在香港」為主題，呈獻本地創意美食。
主辦單位表示，今年場地範圍有所擴展，並設品酒導賞及大師班。詳情及門票可透過官方渠道查詢。
